# Design template contract

<!-- Generated by `make contract` from src/templates/ (context.rs, contract.rs,
contract_intro.md). Do not edit by hand: a unit test fails when this file
drifts from the code. -->

What every template of the public site receives. Templates are
[MiniJinja](https://docs.rs/minijinja) (Jinja2 syntax); HTML output is
auto-escaped by file extension, so emit pre-rendered HTML with `| safe`.

## Template resolution

A template name `X` loads `templates/X`, the first of:

1. `DESIGN_DIR/templates/X` — dev-only local folder.
2. The storage override `design/templates/X` — edited in the bucket or the
   admin Design page, applied by a design reload.
3. The baked default bundle (`design/templates/X` in the repository).

`{% extends %}`, `{% include %}` and `{% import %}` resolve the same way.
Static files follow the same order under `assets/`.

## Undefined values

Every variable below is always present; an absent value is `none` (test it
with `{% if x %}` or `x is none`), never undefined. Live rendering is lenient,
but the design smoke render (run before a design is published) renders every
template with strict undefined handling: referencing a variable or attribute
not listed here is an error.

## Filters

Besides MiniJinja's built-in filters:

- `timeformat(format="%d. %m. %Y %H:%M")` — formats a `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS[.f]`
  (or `T`-separated) timestamp or a `YYYY-MM-DD` date with a
  [chrono `strftime`](https://docs.rs/chrono/latest/chrono/format/strftime/)
  format; any other value is returned unchanged.
  Example: `{{ page.modified_at | timeformat("%d. %m. %Y") }}`.

## URLs

- `/assets/{path}` — a static file of the design (`assets/{path}`).
- `/files/{hash}` — a stored file's bytes by SHA-256; `/files/{hash}/nahled` —
  its thumbnail (images).
- `/{path}` — a page or menu item; `/` is the home menu item (path `""`).
- `/search` — search (`q`, `tag`, `path`, `limit`, `offset`); `/tag/{id}`
  redirects to `/search?tag={name}`.
- `/admin` — the admin; `/admin/pages/{id}/edit`, `/admin/menu/{id}/edit` edit
  a page or menu item.
- `/sitemap.xml`; `/{path}?format=pdf|slides` — the page exported.
